title: PureFPS
description: Lightweight Fabric optimization modpack focused on maximum FPS and minimal bloat.
body:
# PureFPS

A lightweight Fabric optimization modpack focused on maximizing FPS, reducing stutters, improving chunk loading, and keeping the game feeling close to vanilla Minecraft.

Unlike many oversized optimization packs, PureFPS uses a carefully selected set of performance mods and tuned configurations instead of unnecessary bloat. The result is a fast, smooth, responsive experience with excellent compatibility and minimal overhead.

## Features

* Lightweight setup with only 24 mod files
* Massive FPS improvements
* Reduced stuttering and lag spikes
* Faster chunk loading
* Improved memory usage
* Better entity and rendering performance
* Multiplayer friendly
* Close-to-vanilla experience
* Shader compatible

## Included Optimizations

* Rendering optimizations
* Memory optimizations
* Networking optimizations
* Chunk loading improvements
* Entity culling improvements
* General engine performance enhancements

## Tested Performance

Tested on:

* RX 580
* Ryzen 5 4500U
* 32GB DDR4 RAM

Results reached up to ~1300 FPS using:

* 8 render distance
* 5 simulation distance

Performance may vary depending on hardware, shaders, settings, and world complexity.

## Loader

* Fabric Loader 0.19.2

## Goal

The goal of this modpack is simple:
PureFPS.

No unnecessary mods.
No feature bloat.
Just performance.
